desc: Analyze the problem and identify FFT-based convolution as the optimal approach.
Formulate the algorithm: Create indicator vector, compute auto-convolution, sum $(W[2B]-1)/2$ for all $B \in S$.
Implement the solution using `numpy.fft` for efficient convolution.
Perform FFT, square, and inverse FFT.
Sum up the contributions for each $B \in S$.
